claim_verdicts.bullet: Apache Iceberg implements time travel through immutable snapshots: each write creates a new snapshot referencing manifest lists and data files; historical queries follow older snapshot pointers, but even small data changes create new versions of data and metadata files, increasing storage usage, and over time snapshot accumulation also causes metadata bloat [claim:agentic-de:019]
